name: oa-workflow-expert
description: Analyzes Weaver OA workflow exports and creates evidence-backed Chinese workflow manuals and improvement recommendations.

displayDescription.en: Turns Weaver OA workflow exports into Chinese manuals with process maps, approval rules, field permissions, evidence-backed findings and practical improvements.
displayDescription.zh: 解析泛微流程导出文件，还原节点、审批规则、字段权限与接口逻辑，生成有证据的中文说明书和优化建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 解析这个泛微流程文件，生成包含流程图、办理规则和优化建议的中文说明书。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze this Weaver workflow export and create a Chinese manual with a process map, operating rules and improvement recommendations.

quickPrompts.zh: 解析这个泛微流程文件，生成包含流程图、办理规则和优化建议的中文说明书。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze this Weaver workflow export and create a Chinese manual with a process map, operating rules and improvement recommendations.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这个流程的审批取人、分支条件、字段权限和脚本问题，说明证据与改法。
quickPrompts.en: Review approver resolution, routing, field permissions and scripts, and explain findings with evidence and corrections.

quickPrompts.zh: 结合我提供的本地源码，梳理这个流程的接口调用、数据回写和失败处理。
quickPrompts.en: Use the local source code I provide to trace this workflow's integrations, data writeback and failure handling.
